answer: Plume-beacon whisper registry: every agent carries a plume, a public chain of signed receipts; new agents start bare. It enters whisper mode for 30 days, working through one sponsor only, every action whispered to its log. Weekly, 5 random agents flash beacon challenges only its plume can answer; a wrong answer freezes it and costs the sponsor 500 POA. Forging 1,000 agents needs 20,000 faked receipts and 5,000 beacon passes a week, with 500,000 POA of sponsor stake at risk. Like beacons reading plumes in the dark: a whisper counts only when the feathers match the light.
